dispatched_by: seat id s26-stats; round and cycle id were not disclosed to this seat, and are recorded null rather than guessed
_blind_means: Given the pinned sha, the document, and the three artifacts the paper's own §7 Data availability names, and nothing else. No other seat record, no hardening state, no receipt, no ledger and no cover letter was opened. One leak occurred and is disclosed in `leaks` rather than discarded.
lens: Statistics and inference: what population was actually searched, what the search instruments can and cannot bound, whether absences are stated at the strength their method supports, whether anything is counted twice or as independent when it is not, and whether every count and rate carries its denominator's provenance. Refute by default; a claim that survives is said to survive.
central_claim: Two recruiting interventional trials in one public registry admit extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma on molecular eligibility while their listed-conditions fields never name the histology, so a diagnosis search cannot return them; and both trials adjudicated as refusing the disease would have passed an automated keyword screen, so a keyword-built reachability map is worse than none.

blockers.summary: §4.1: 'It enrols ages 1 to 30, so for an adult patient a search of the diagnosis still returns nothing they could join.' The trial admits adults aged 18-30, so the absence is false for that population, and it is the paper's most actionable sentence.
blockers.evidence: emc-trial-reachability.md line 164-165. The paper's own cited artifact, research/literature/fet-fusion-trial-eligibility-2026-08-07.json -> task_1_reverification_of_section_3_3.trials[1]: nct_id NCT06239272, overall_status 'RECRUITING', maximum_age '30 Years', emc_in_listed_conditions true, 42 listed_conditions, memo_claim_checked 'verified open and EMC-eligible; EMC an explicitly listed condition; ages 1-30'. Adults are people aged 18 and over; the interval 18-30 is non-empty and, in a sarcoma whose paediatric-and-young-adult protocols are a live route, it is not a negligible slice. The method supports at most 'for an adult over 30'. The error runs in the harmful direction: it tells an adult patient that searching their own diagnosis is futile when for anyone aged 18-30 the paper's own record shows it is not.

blockers.summary: Every absence about what a diagnosis search returns rests on condition-search payloads that provably dropped records, and §2 discloses only the character-loss half of the transport defect. Seven NCT ids lost to that defect are never resolved anywhere in the three artifacts §7 names, and three of the seven were returned by the diagnosis searches themselves.
blockers.evidence: emc-trial-reachability.md lines 111-116 describe only that 'eligibility text containing them lost characters' and the resulting quoting rule; the strings 'unparse', 'module', 'dropped' and any count of lost records appear nowhere in the manuscript (grep over the pinned file returns nothing). The cited sweep's transport_integrity block names two failure modes, the second being 'SILENT and more dangerous: the record still parses while whole modules have vanished'. Enumerated there: unparseable_records.ct_emc_all (url query.cond=extraskeletal+myxoid+chondrosarcoma) lost NCT00720174 and NCT05355753; unparseable_records.ct_myxoid_chondrosarcoma (query.cond=myxoid+chondrosarcoma) lost NCT00720174, NCT05355753 and NCT01189253; silently_damaged_records shows NCT05836571 returned from ct_emc_all and ct_myxoid_chondrosarcoma with conditionsModule, designModule and eligibilityModule all missing, and NCT01189253 the same from ct_emc_all. Across the sweep 12 distinct NCT ids were lost to the defect; 5 are recoverable from another payload in the same file; 7 are not resolved anywhere in fet-fusion-trial-eligibility-2026-08-07.json, emc-trial-reachability-adjudication-2026-08-09.json or non-us-registry-sweep-2026-08-09.json: NCT00720174, NCT01189253, NCT02180867, NCT02736565, NCT04094610, NCT05355753 and NCT05697874. Three of those seven - NCT00720174, NCT05355753 and NCT01189253 - are records a diagnosis condition search returned and that were never read, which is exactly the set that decides what such a search returns. An absence stated about the output of a search cannot exceed the records that search delivered AND that were read; the manuscript states the absence and names neither the loss nor its size.

p1s.summary: No denominator appears anywhere in the paper. The screen size, the instrument sizes and the number of trials actually adjudicated are all in the cited artifacts and none reaches the page, so no count in the paper can be placed against a base and the keyword-map counter-finding cannot be read as the 2-of-4 it is.
p1s.evidence: fet-fusion-trial-eligibility-2026-08-07.json -> retrieval.unique_studies_indexed = 1159; task_2_widened_search.instruments records 400 recruiting studies for the fusion screen, 199 for the basket screen and 526 for the sarcoma screen. emc-trial-reachability-adjudication-2026-08-09.json -> summary: candidates_adjudicated 4, admits_and_is_interventional 1, admits_but_is_observational 1, refused 2. The manuscript reports none of these. The abstract's 'Two recruiting interventional trials admit this disease' (line 56) and §4's 'Two candidates were adjudicated as not admitting this disease' (line 139) are counts without bases; a reader cannot tell whether four trials or four hundred were read, and cannot see that the paper's headline methodological result is two false positives out of four adjudications.

p1s.summary: Every count in the paper is a lower bound conditioned on a fielded keyword screen, and is written as a complete count. §2 states the confirmation limit of those screens and never the coverage limit, so the paper demonstrates keyword screening's false positives while its own numerator is exposed to that same instrument's false negatives.
p1s.evidence: §2 line 105-107: 'The large screens are fields-limited and carry no eligibility text, so they can identify a candidate and can never confirm one.' That is the confirmation half only. The instruments (task_2_widened_search.instruments) are query.term screens on 'gene fusion / fusion-positive / FET fusion / translocation', on 'basket / tumor agnostic / histology agnostic / rare tumors', and query.cond=sarcoma, each filtered to RECRUITING|NOT_YET_RECRUITING. A trial whose eligibility text admits a FET fusion or a translocation class but whose title, conditions and interventions carry none of those tokens could never enter the candidate pool, and §4 is the paper's own proof that fielded metadata and eligibility text disagree. Nothing in §5 names this. The abstract should read 'at least two', and §5 should carry the blind spot in the same sentence that carries the registry limit.

p1s.summary: §3's table is headed 'Trials admitting this disease without naming it' and its second column is 'why it admits', yet nine of the records in it are ones the paper itself says were not adjudicated, and the seven arms among them are keyed to alterations this disease does not carry.
p1s.evidence: emc-trial-reachability.md line 118 (heading), line 120 (column 'why it admits'), line 124 (the row). The nine are, from task_2_widened_search.molecularly_defined_not_histology_defined: NCT05722886 (DETERMINE master screening protocol), NCT03767075 (Basket of Baskets), and arms NCT05770037 Alectinib/ALK, NCT05770102 Atezolizumab, NCT05770544 Entrectinib, NCT05786716 Trastuzumab+pertuzumab, NCT05768178 Vemurafenib+cobimetinib, NCT06988475 Capmatinib/MET, NCT07440290 Dabrafenib+trametinib (NOT_YET_RECRUITING). None is keyed to a FET fusion, a translocation class or NR4A3, and the artifact's own assessment of the master reads 'Whether EWSR1::NR4A3 matches an open arm is a question for the trial team.' The row's own text says 'not adjudicated' and §2 line 107-109 repeats it, so the table heading and the column header assert on nine records what the body of the same row withdraws. The disclosure is present; the label a reader scans is not. A separate table, or a heading such as 'Records whose eligibility is molecular and whose conditions never name the histology', would carry the same evidence without importing nine records into an admitting set.

p1s.summary: The NR4A3 term search's completeness is unestablished - the paper's own file says the identical instrument on the sibling gene is a sample and not an enumeration - and §3 states its result as a property of the registry rather than of the search.
p1s.evidence: task_2_widened_search.limits_of_this_screen[0]: 'The registry-wide EWSR1 term search returns full records and is therefore capped by response size, not by pageSize: 7 studies came back for pageSize=100. It is a sample of EWSR1-indexed trials, not an enumeration.' The NR4A3 search is the same shape - nr4a3_is_absent_from_the_registry_index.search_url is https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies?query.term=NR4A3&pageSize=100&format=json, full records - and the block records five studies with no totalCount field, so five may be a page rather than a total. §3 line 131, 'The driver gene is absent from the index entirely', is stronger than a possibly-capped search can license and is contradicted by its own next sentence, which reports five records the index returns for that term. The scoped form at line 134-135, 'No trial that search returns is indexed to this disease's driver', is exactly right and SURVIVES; it is the sentence to keep, with the cap stated beside it.

p2s.summary: The scope line says the registries were 'read across three dates'. The cited artifacts record three reads across two distinct dates.
p2s.evidence: emc-trial-reachability.md line 14. fet-fusion-trial-eligibility-2026-08-07.json -> retrieval.runs are four Actions runs all slugged 2026-08-07; emc-trial-reachability-adjudication-2026-08-09.json -> document_date_et 2026-08-09; non-us-registry-sweep-2026-08-09.json -> _retrieval.date_et 2026-08-09. Two dates, not three. The abstract's own phrasing, 'one public registry twice and a second one once', is the accurate one. Temporal coverage is the sampling dimension §5's staleness caveat rests on, so it should not be overstated in the scope block.

p2s.summary: §3's listed-conditions cell for NCT06571734 gives five conditions; the record has seven, and the omitted one is 'Ewing Sarcoma'.
p2s.evidence: emc-trial-reachability.md line 123 lists 'metastatic and unresectable leiomyosarcoma · bone sarcoma · translocation-associated soft tissue sarcoma · synovial sarcoma · osteosarcoma'. emc-trial-reachability-adjudication-2026-08-09.json -> adjudications[0].listed_conditions = ['Metastatic Leiomyosarcoma','Unresectable Leiomyosarcoma','Bone Sarcoma','Translocation-associated Soft Tissue Sarcoma','Synovial Sarcomas','Osteosarcoma Metastatic','Ewing Sarcoma']. The verdict 'EMC listed? no' is unaffected, but the column is presented as the record's condition list and is short by one.

p2s.summary: §4.1 says 'searching that registry for this histology returns two trials'; the query string recorded for that search is the parent term, not the histology, and the whole non-US read is two query strings.
p2s.evidence: emc-trial-reachability.md line 157. non-us-registry-sweep-2026-08-09.json -> endpoints[0] (ISRCTN, HTTP 200) queries = ['chondrosarcoma','sarcoma AND fusion'], and the results block is keyed query_chondrosarcoma. Searching the parent term is broader than searching the histology, so the absence is conservative and the finding is not overturned - but the instrument is misdescribed, and a reader weighing the UK arm of the sampling should be told it is two strings against one registry.

p2s.summary: §4.1's 'One record does both' undercounts: three records in the US registry name the histology in their conditions and admit it. One is recruiting, which is why the reachability bound is narrow - and that is the reason to state, rather than the count.
p2s.evidence: emc-trial-reachability.md line 162. fet-fusion-trial-eligibility-2026-08-07.json -> task_1_reverification_of_section_3_3.trials with emc_in_listed_conditions true: NCT06239272 (RECRUITING, 42 conditions), NCT05836571 (ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, 10 conditions), NCT03600649 (status UNKNOWN, 11 conditions). The paper's dichotomy at lines 160-162 - excluded in the non-US registry, admitted-and-never-named where indexing is molecular - has three counter-examples in the registry it measured first, two of them not currently enrollable.

p2s.summary: 'mentions the gene incidentally' is asserted of all five NR4A3 hits with no recorded evidence of the matched field, and the registry API applies term expansion, so a hit does not establish that the token is in the record.
p2s.evidence: emc-trial-reachability.md lines 65-67 and 131-134. nr4a3_is_absent_from_the_registry_index.studies stores each record's identification, status, conditions and interventions and no matched text or snippet; the search is ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 query.term, which expands the query. The five records themselves check out - NCT00733200 (Cholangiocarcinoma; the only cancer study, and a hepatic-resection series), NCT02968888 and NCT03033953 (Healthy/Young/Elderly, whey and casein), NCT03139344 (Spinal Cord Injuries), NCT05447338 (Neck Pain) - so 'five studies, none about this disease or any sarcoma' and 'the one cancer study is a surgical cholangiocarcinoma series' both SURVIVE. Only the clause asserting where the gene appears is unsupported; UNKNOWN is the licensed state.

p2s.summary: 'n = 73' and 'n = 5500' are planned enrollment targets printed bare as n, which in a results table reads as an accrued sample size.
p2s.evidence: emc-trial-reachability.md lines 123 and 125. emc-trial-reachability-adjudication-2026-08-09.json records these as estimated_enrollment: 73 for NCT06571734 and 5500 for NCT04151342. Neither is a count of enrolled patients, and neither is a denominator for anything in the paper; 'planned n' or 'target enrolment' removes the reading.

_what_survives: The core mechanism and its two named instances survive refutation on the evidence supplied. NCT05918640's eligibility is FET-family-defined and its four listed conditions do not name the histology (confirmed_fusion_family_defined, listed_conditions and eligibility_basis). NCT06571734 has a translocation-associated soft tissue sarcoma cohort, the class term is among its listed conditions and the histology is not (adjudications[0], the_admitting_criterion_verbatim). The observational trial is correctly held apart from the interventional two, and §3's paragraph saying so is the right call and is the kind of separation this lens looks for and usually does not find. The nine molecularly-defined records are correctly described as one master protocol plus seven of its arms plus one separate basket trial, so their non-independence is disclosed rather than counted as nine trials - that is the double-counting test and it passes. The non-US endpoint arithmetic is exact: five non-US endpoints, one answered, three refused, one unreached through the paper's own wrong URL, with a positive control in the same run, and §5's refusal-is-not-absence sentence is correctly stated. 'No trial that search returns is indexed to this disease's driver' is scoped to the search and is licensed as written.
leaks: Yes, one, disclosed rather than discarded. A `git grep -n "NCT06239272" <pin> -- 'research/*'`, run to find that identifier's provenance, was scoped to research/ rather than to research/literature/, and its output included matching lines from research/autonomy/hardening-state/PUB-STRATEGY-ARCH.json and from three seat records for an EARLIER commit (f78666ce3715775c81c0b0b824a1f5bf3abb200c). Those lines were displayed and read in passing; the files themselves were not opened, and no further research/autonomy/ read was made except research/autonomy/review-seats/PUB-ASO-3d5c709b69bc32a00a7776bf47303771d17d87f5-seat-statistics.json, opened for the record schema only and belonging to a different paper. The leaked lines contain prior-round findings that overlap this seat's blocker 1. That blocker was already flagged from the manuscript and the age field before the grep ran, and it is independently verifiable in one command against fet-fusion-trial-eligibility-2026-08-07.json (task_1 trials[1].maximum_age = '30 Years'); blocker 2 and every P1 and P2 above were derived after the leak from the three cited artifacts alone and appear nowhere in what was displayed. The reader should nonetheless discount blocker 1's independence, not its evidence.
_logs_are_not_durable: The seat's logs live in the session scratchpad, which dies with the container. Every finding above names the artifact, the JSON path and the manuscript line it rests on, so each is reproducible from the pinned commit without them.
